reviews.title: Sounds great, looks great, and overall very nice
reviews.comment: Keyboard was super easy to set up! Keys also sound amazing and I love the unique font and graphics that are on the keys. Being able to have a keyboard that looks custom for such a good price is awesome for someone like me who is new to PC gaming but loves aesthetics. The smaller screen is also super nice with showing the time and making it easy to adjust the RGB of the keyboard itself. I will note that I can't figure out how to change the date on the keyboard screen and it's set to one day ahead of the current date, but that's not a major issue and probably something I am just not figuring out yet. The volume control knob also works great and is a nice added convenience. Very happy with my purchase and will recommend this keyboard to others!
reviews.author: DeL B

reviews.title: Well worth it!!
reviews.comment: Absolutely loving this keyboard by Redragon!! When I was looking to upgrade my keyboard this was one of the options I was considering and I’m so happy I went with it. I love the feel of this board when typing, depending on how hard you push and how fast do you type the sound is great not too overwhelming and the feel it gives is very soft and smooth. It’s super easy to customize, the software was fairly easy to find on their website and uploading gifs and changing the rgb is very easy to figure out. Compared to the other keyboards, I was looking at this one isn’t expensive at all and is still a great quality keyboard. If your thinking about getting it you won’t regret it!!
reviews.author: Lauren & Richard

reviews.title: Way better than I expected, great entrance to mechanical keyboards.
reviews.comment: I wanted to build my own keyboard, but wanted a small form with a number pad. the cheapest barebones kit that met that criteria was over $80, so I figured I'd give this a shot. I have never had/used a mechanical keyboard and didn't want to put a ton of money into it right away. I also didn't want a super loud click, I think those ones sound really annoying. I was very pleasantly surprised by the feel, quality, weight, and sound of this. I actually am able  to type faster on this than my old membrane keyboard. The RGB is way better than I was expecting, it's bright, has tons of modes, and the battery is surprisingly long with it on. Connectivity hasn't been an issue either, I have the usb dongle in my computer, and the bluetooth linked to my phone so I can quickly switch between them if I have a long text to send. My brother is a mechanical keyboard snob, and he was very surprised by how quality this felt and typed. The switches are smooth and quiet enough that I don't feel a need to change them, but I like that I have that option for so little cost. I think my only criticism is that I wish the keyboard was a little wider so that the 0 key in the numpad could be a full size. I still hit the right arrow button a lot when I'm using the numpad quickly. Overall it's not too big of a deal though.
reviews.author: Kevin M.

reviews.title: Love this keyboard and the company!
reviews.comment: I have had this keyboard for a couple of months now and I gotta say that it is so gorgeous! I get compliments on it all the time at work and I love bragging about it! The keyboard is made well, it is able to handle my incessant pounding and the sound is light enough to not bother my coworkers. The keys have a milky quality to them, so if you like a noisy keyboard this isn’t for you, but the layout and the larger than average lettering has made my typing speed so much better. I don’t often use it off the usb wire, but what I have seen indicates that it has a good amount of battery life. One of the keys came damaged and while the company was not able to get me a replacement, they did give me some credit back on the keyboard. Considering similar keyboards are in the $100+ range, this one is a good option for those wanting to either dip their toes into mechanical keyboards or budget-conscious folks.
reviews.author: Krys

reviews.title: I love this keyboard
reviews.comment: I have owned several red dragon mechanical keyboards over the years, I love them for their high quality and low price, but this is by FAR my favorite keyboard so far. The keys are mint switches which I've never tried but I'll never not use again, they feel and sound absolutely amazing. When you're typing away you don't get that loud, audio spiking click like a red or blue switch, you get a solid low thud. It sounds like raindrops hitting a wood roof, you could easily sleep through it. The tactile sensation doesn't even suffer like having a membrane keyboard, it provides a nice balanced resistance force that thuds right when it bottoms out, something that's hard to describe the feel of. I cannot stand a numpad-less keyboard so the inclusion of this full sized numpad while keeping the overall size relatively small is phenomenal. The volume knob has a nice tactile feel as well. The little LCD screen is awesome, and surprisingly crisp at a low resolution thanks to its small size. A lot of keyboards have had monochrome screens in them but this one is full color and you can upload your own gifs to the app, which you'll need to download in order to customize the keys, RGB, and screen. I wish it had SignalRGB or openRGB support but unfortunately it does not. The frame is plastic, usually red dragon makes nice cheap metal frame keyboards, but it doesn't flex when you're typing on it so it's a pass for me. It can flex a little bit you need to be deliberately trying. This also makes it a little on the lighter side so it's easier to accidentally move. Note: -You might need to download the red dragon k719 software and update the firmware with it in order for the windows key (and some others) to work
